name: Grunt
prompt: Create one full-length portrait of Grunt, the fictional krogan character in the two official Mass Effect reference images. Use his recognizable orange and gold face, gray-brown head crest, broad body shape and the same pale gray armor with small blue lights. Closely follow the exact armor panels and proportions shown in the references. The character stands calmly in three-quarter view, oriented toward the right side of the image, arms relaxed with empty hands, both feet visible. One single figure, from the top of the head to the bottom of the toes, with generous empty margins. Realistic game-character illustration with soft even studio light. No background scenery, no floor, no captions, no extra figures or visual effects. Transparent alpha background.

name: Cora Harper
prompt: Create exactly ONE isolated full-body character concept of CORA HARPER, the fictional adult woman from Mass Effect Andromeda, following the three official BioWare costume reference pages. They supply identity, costume and details; do not reproduce their collage layouts or background. Preserve her recognizable adult face, light skin, brown/hazel eyes, short pale ash-blonde asymmetric haircut with the cropped side on her ANATOMICAL RIGHT and longer side-swept fringe on her LEFT. Reproduce her precise gray-white, graphite and cobalt-blue Initiative suit with its high white collar, dark sculpted front torso panels, narrow blue upper chest band and small Initiative marking. IMPORTANT physical asymmetry: her ANATOMICAL LEFT forearm/outer sleeve is cobalt blue with a pale glove; her ANATOMICAL RIGHT arm is gray/black with a dark glove and light elbow and wrist hardware. Match the exact shoulder plates and markings to the reference; do not mirror or make the sleeves identical. Keep the diagonal waist strap, reference thigh straps and pouch positions, light textured outer thigh panels, dark knees, fitted gray shin panels and light segmented boots. Her left thigh has the slim pouch group; her right thigh has the darker paired straps. Use the kit's actual costume seams and proportions, no N7 emblem, no improvised armor pieces. Show Cora in one restrained low ready pose facing SCREEN RIGHT, head and torso in a readable three-quarter profile, eyes looking right, feet planted and independently visible, arms separated slightly from the torso with empty hands in natural low guard. She holds no weapon; leave off the reference firearm. Completely full body from hair to both boot soles, no cropping, entire character occupying no more than eighty-two percent of canvas height with ample transparent margin above and below. Realistic faithful game-character finish, soft neutral studio illumination and crisp readable silhouette. ONE individual, ONE view. No words, labels, scenery, platform, floor, ground shadow, decorative frame, hologram or effects. TRUE transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard, not the dark teal background of the references.

name: Liam Kosta
prompt: Create ONE isolated full-length character concept of LIAM KOSTA, the fictional adult Mass Effect Andromeda character shown in these three official BioWare reference pages. Match his recognizable face, dark brown skin, brown eyes, short irregular textured twists/afro hair and athletic adult human proportions. The source kit is the authority for every garment and equipment shape. Exact outfit: weathered off-white high-collar jacket with a vertical center zipper, narrow blue collar line, blue curving side-torso inserts, pale ribbed side panels, Initiative chest marking and white front harness loops with circular blue clips. Keep the raised white tab with a round blue disc on his ANATOMICAL RIGHT shoulder; do not make the shoulders symmetrical. Preserve the compact pale back harness module visible from this angle, the articulated white/gray shoulder and forearm pieces with circular blue wrist details, pale-and-dark padded gloves, segmented light gray belt, pouch at his anatomical LEFT hip. Lower half: dark upper hip section, dark blue fabric cargo trousers, black segmented rectangular thigh pads, separate gray mechanical knee pads, black padding beneath knees and dark calf-high practical boots. Follow the detailed kit's seams, panel layout, fasteners and color divisions. Do not add a helmet, N7 emblem, improvised armor or oversized backpack. Show one full-body figure facing SCREEN RIGHT, three-quarter profile, focused neutral expression, restrained low ready stance, arms a little away from his body, empty relaxed hands, knees slightly flexed, feet separated and fully visible. The entire figure should occupy at most eighty-two percent of the total image height, with generous transparent margin above his hair and beneath his boot soles and clear side margins. Realistic game-character materials under neutral soft studio lighting, fine but restrained surface detail, clean crisp silhouette. ONE character, ONE view only, no sheet or collage. No weapon, omni-tool, biotic effect, scenery, floor, platform, cast ground shadow, caption, border or extra markings. TRUE transparent alpha background, no teal backdrop and no rendered checkerboard.
